name: AVAILABILITY_CALENDAR_URL
label: Availability calendar address
help: The calendar holding your OPEN events. The system only ever reads it.

name: AVAILABILITY_USERNAME
label: Availability username
help: The account the availability calendar belongs to.

name: AVAILABILITY_PASSWORD
label: Availability app password
help: An app password minted for this — never your ordinary login password.

name: BOOKING_STORE_URL
label: Booking calendar address
help: Where confirmed bookings are written, as ordinary calendar events.

name: BOOKING_STORE_USERNAME
label: Booking username
help: The account the booking calendar belongs to.

name: BOOKING_STORE_PASSWORD
label: Booking app password
help: An app password for the booking calendar.

name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
label: Service-account key file
help: The whole JSON key file of the Google Cloud service account both calendars are shared with.

name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
label: API token
help: Lets the deploy run publish the booking API to your Cloudflare account.

name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
label: Account ID
help: On your Cloudflare dashboard's overview page, right-hand column — 32 characters.

name: BREVO_API_KEY
label: Brevo API key
help: Lets the system hand your confirmation emails to Brevo for delivery.

name: SENDER_EMAIL
label: Sender address
help: The From: address — at your own domain, and a real mailbox you read.

name: PRACTITIONER_EMAIL
label: Your notification address
help: Gets a notice on every booking. Leave empty for none.

name: SENDER_NAME
label: Sender name
help: The name shown beside the sender address; “Bookings” if left empty.

name: DISPLAY_TIMEZONE
label: Timezone
help: Appointment times in the emails are written in this zone.

name: SLOT_MINUTES
label: Appointment length (minutes)
help: Every OPEN block is cut into slots of this length.

name: MIN_NOTICE_MINUTES
label: Minimum notice (minutes)
help: How close to now a slot may still be booked — 120 blocks the next two hours.

name: BOOKING_HORIZON_DAYS
label: Booking horizon (days)
help: How far ahead customers can see and book.

name: MAX_SLOTS
label: Most slots ever listed
help: A safety cap on one page load; the default is plenty.

name: GRANT_TTL_SECS
label: Booking grant lifetime (seconds)
help: How long a customer has between seeing a slot and confirming it.

name: PROOF_MAX_AGE_SECS
label: Proof freshness (seconds)
help: Anti-replay window on booking requests; leave as is.
